prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A quiet contemporary Chinese hospital outpatient waiting area as a reusable EMPTY background plate for medical education paper-theatre animation. Wide landscape composition, tactile layered cut paper and watercolor, soft muted cream and sage palette. Benches along rear wall, unlettered closed doors on far sides, a blank reception window in rear corner. Large uncluttered open foreground floor and blank central wall for separately composited full-body characters. Correct simple perspective, human scale. No people, no writing/signage/numbers/logo/watermark, no emergency drama. Entire opaque illustration. Furniture and architecture are intentionally a single static backdrop; no operation depicted.

review.title: 候诊区空场背景板
review.note: 已看空场、中央留白与透视；整幅不透明背景，家具、门窗和接待台不可独立操作。
